alternatives.option: Reproduce admitted output exactly, authorize cancel only on proven ownership, and name unknown ownership distinctly when proof fails.

consequences: Replay must include structural crossing, paired code and owner; failed attribution remains non-mutating and directs resolve-and-continue, not a false later-work claim.
